infoPlist.NSCameraUsageDescription: FutureMe uses the camera to capture photos inside the app before you publish them.
infoPlist.NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: FutureMe uses the microphone to record audio tracks that the app attaches to your creations.
infoPlist.NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: FutureMe accesses your photo library to let you choose media that appears in the app.
infoPlist.NSMotionUsageDescription: FutureMe uses motion data to run movement-based features you enable in the app.
